svg.title: Sluice · system topology
svg.desc: Open this file in diagrams.net to edit it: the draw.io model is embedded.
svg.text: takes over when A's lease expires
a branch tree, not a log
Separate OS processes on one host, Redis in Docker, one shared SQLite journal. Nothing grades itself: the orchestrator acts, the ledger records, the checker compares.
producer XADDs synthetic alerts to the stream
XREADGROUP, at-least-once; the standby XAUTOCLAIMs what a dead leader left
every step: INTENT journaled, effect, RESULT journaled
HTTP with an idempotency key + epoch; a stale epoch gets 409
the services, not the orchestrator, record what happened
the checker grades intent (journal) against ground truth (ledger)
the dashboard only reads: if it dies, the system keeps running
